title: Rethinking Data Augmentation under Covariate Shift: Invariant-Guided Diffusion and Prototype Reweighting
abstract: arXiv:2610.00873v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In many industrial applications, 1) tabular data is scarce and imbalanced and thus requires synthetic expansion; 2) input distributions drift between training and deployment (covariate shift); 3) validation sets often diverge from unseen test environments; or 4) standard generative models simply mimic outdated source distributions. This learning setting limits the stability of standard augmentation and adaptation pipelines. We generalize the task under such setting as the Augmented and Weighted Learning under Covariate Shift problem (AWL-CS). AWL-CS imposes two critical challenges on existing methods: 1) misleading generative guidance where models optimize for source similarity rather than downstream task relevance, and 2) structural instability of distributional density where reweighting mechanisms overfit to noisy validation signals. To tackle these challenges, we propose IGDPR (Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting),

translated_title: 重新思考协变量偏移下的数据增强：不变性引导扩散与原型重加权
translated_abstract: 在许多工业应用中，1）表格数据稀缺且不平衡，因此需要进行合成扩充；2）输入分布在训练与部署之间发生漂移（即协变量偏移）；3）验证集往往与未见过的测试环境不一致；4）标准生成模型只是简单地模仿过时的源分布。这种学习环境限制了标准增强与自适应流程的稳定性。我们将这种设定下的任务泛化为“协变量偏移下的增强与加权学习问题”（AWL-CS）。AWL-CS 对现有方法提出了两个关键挑战：1）误导性的生成引导，即模型针对源分布相似性而非下游任务相关性进行优化；2）分布密度的结构不稳定性，即重加权机制容易过度拟合含噪的验证信号。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了 IGDPR（不变性引导扩散与原型重加权），
tldr: 提出协变量偏移下的增强与加权学习问题（AWL-CS），并设计IGDPR方法，利用不变性引导扩散与原型重加权解决生成引导误导和重加权不稳定这两大挑战。
en_tdlr: Proposes the Augmented and Weighted Learning under Covariate Shift (AWL-CS) problem and introduces IGDPR, which tackles misleading generative guidance and reweighting instability via invariant-guided diffusion and prototype reweighting.
